finalText:
**Big but shallow.** 1,291 uses across 94 files. Roughly 1,030 are plain variable names. Those rename safely.

Six spots must keep the old name:

| Must stay `account_id` | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `migrations/*.sql` | Already ran in production |
| SQL text inside `services/` | Real database column name |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | Public API, breaks clients |
| `lib/serialize.js` | Public field name |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | A refresh wipes edits |
| payload JSON in repo files | Old rows keep old key |

Also check `req.session.account_id`. That session object is built outside this repo.
